forceDelete.title: Permanently delete this user?
forceDelete.description: The account {{name}} (UID {{uid}}) and all its data will be removed. This can't be undone. To only hide the account, use Soft delete.

forceDelete.title: Permanently delete profile?
forceDelete.description: {{name}} ({{code}}, UID {{uid}}) and its avatar will be removed from the system. This can't be undone. To only hide it, use Soft-delete.

forceDelete.description: {{name}} (ID {{id}}) will be removed from the database. This cannot be undone; profiles, classrooms or exams that use it may be affected. To only hide it, use Soft-delete.

forceDelete.title: Delete role permanently?
forceDelete.description: {{name}} ({{code}}) will be removed from the database. This can't be undone. To only hide it, use Soft-delete.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Devices users have signed in from. A trusted device skips the OTP step at sign-in.
devices.thisBrowserWarning: This is the device you are using. After this, your next sign-in will ask for an OTP again.
devices.pickTitle: Pick a user to see their devices
devices.pickDescription: Enter a user's UID, or a device ID to find its owner. You can also open this from View devices on the Users screen.

lookup.label: Device lookup
lookup.noOwner: This device isn't linked to a user.

actions.adminOnly: Only ADMIN accounts can delete permanently

revoke.title: Revoke trust for this device?
revoke.description: {{name}} (ID {{id}}, UID {{uid}}) will no longer be trusted: the next sign-in from it asks for an OTP, and its sign-in history is marked revoked.

softDelete.title: Soft-delete this device?
softDelete.description: {{name}} (ID {{id}}, UID {{uid}}) will be hidden from the list and its sign-in history marked revoked. There is no restore yet.

forceDelete.title: Delete this device permanently?
forceDelete.description: {{name}} (ID {{id}}, UID {{uid}}) will be removed from the database. This can't be undone. To only hide it, use Soft-delete.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.selfSignOutWarning: This is the session you are using: you will be signed out right away.

markSecure.noUser: Nobody is signed into this session, so it can't be marked verified.
markSecure.title: Mark this session verified?
markSecure.description: The session of {{account}} (UID {{uid}}, token {{token}}) counts as fully signed in, skipping the OTP step. Only do this when you are sure the device belongs to the account owner.

markUnsecure.title: Unverify this session?
markUnsecure.description: The session of {{account}} (UID {{uid}}, token {{token}}) is kept, but every sign-in-only feature refuses it until the user signs in again (or it is marked verified again).

deleteOne.title: Sign out this session?
deleteOne.description: The session of {{account}} (UID {{uid}}, token {{token}}) is deleted. On its next request that device has to sign in again.

deleteUnsecure.title: Delete unverified sessions?
deleteUnsecure.description: Every session that never finished login/OTP, or was signed out, is deleted. Your own session is not affected.

deleteAll.title: Delete all sessions?
deleteAll.description: Every user is signed out, <warn>you included</warn>: you will be sent to the sign-in page right after.
deleteAll.done: All sessions deleted. Please sign in again.

server.title: Server
server.description: Restart or stop the math-svr process.

reload.title: Reload
reload.summary: Validates the .env file, then restarts the process in place so new settings apply. If .env is invalid, the server keeps running and reports the error.
reload.confirmDescription: The server is <warn>down for a few seconds</warn>: running requests and socket connections are cut. Sessions survive only when the server has SERIALIZED_SESSION_FILE set.
reload.doneDescription: Wait a few seconds, then reload this page. If it still can't connect, check the server log.

shutdown.title: Shut down
shutdown.summary: Stops the math-svr process once in-flight work has drained. It can only be started again on the host.
shutdown.confirmDescription: The whole NUMI app and this dashboard <warn>stop working</warn> until someone starts the server again on the host.
shutdown.doneDescription: Every request will fail until the server is started again on the host.

data.title: Data
data.description: Watch database connections and wipe test data.

stats.title: MySQL connections
stats.cumulativeHint: Waits, wait time and closed connections add up from when the server started.

clearTables.title: Clear tables
clearTables.summary: Pick tables to empty (TRUNCATE). Each table's id counter is also reset to 0.
clearTables.confirmDescription: Every row in the tables below is deleted. This <warn>cannot be undone</warn>.
clearTables.usersWarning: ma_users is selected: every account is deleted, including the one you are using.

clearAll.title: Clear all data
clearAll.summary: Wipes every table above, keeping only the whitelisted users (and all their data). Reference data (programs, grades, semesters, schools) and the exam pool are kept.
clearAll.confirmDescription: All user, classroom, submission, notification, banner and chat data is deleted. This <warn>cannot be undone</warn>.
clearAll.whitelistHint: Comma-separated UIDs. Leave empty to delete everyone.
clearAll.whitelistInvalid: Enter UID numbers only, separated by commas.
clearAll.selfWarning: Your account (UID {{uid}}) is not in the list and will be deleted.
